action: Go directly to Rick Tanner — not email, not word of mouth — and ask him two specific questions in a direct, brief conversation before the end of this week. Question one: which location is Patricia closing? I understand he may not be able to confirm which one is in his assessment, but I am asking him as the GM I have worked under for years to tell me what he can. Question two: is my position in consideration for the transition pool, or is my location surviving? I am not panicking, I am not making demands — I am a salesperson with two kids asking the person who has the most current information to tell me what he knows. Rick's trust score with me is 0.73. He is not going to lie to me. He may not know the final answer yet, but he will tell me what he has. I need this information before end of week — Patricia said sales floor staff at the closed location will be informed within one week of announcement, and I cannot afford to be the last person to know.
